phases.goal: Grasp the pot handles and lift the pot together.
phases.name: balanced_handle_lift
phases.verify: The pot elevates as one object and remains balanced.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: Phases are transferable task guidance; the companion JSONL is the exact historical winning command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize all objects, supports, contacts, and poses from current observations; do not reuse s0 coordinates.
critical_gates: Both handle contacts are balanced before lift.
Pot rises without tipping or losing a handle.

task_language: Grasp the round kitchenpot with handles and elevate together.
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=2,use_length=50); 2:lingbot_act(chunks=1,use_length=50). For every lingbot_act, use the original task_language exactly; relocalize every pose from current observations; do not replay clean coordinates.

notes: Avoid lifting from one loose handle; verify both pot handles are engaged and the pot rises level before continuing upward.
